lead: A message with the mentions in it shown in bold: the companion of [Mentions](/mentions), what is typed there is shown here. `mentions` are the names someone can be mentioned by; a mention of anyone else stays plain text.

usage.title: Usage
usage.description: `@Ada Lin` and `@Ben Carter` are in the list, `@someone` is not. It renders text only: put it in a Text or a Paragraph.
usage.message: @Ada Lin can you look at this one? @Ben Carter has seen it, and @someone from sales asked twice.

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.description: MentionText renders its mentions as Text `strong` and has no slot of its own.
